public_contents: Complete customized Python runtime and matching web interface
Apple Silicon and macOS patches and native application sources
VK Video, YouTube and RuTube URL queue
Universal Text LLM structural quality audit
Source-aware lexical grounding review tool (not a semantic verifier)
Text LLM benchmark with raw/final output provenance
Local-only MLX/Metal observer and runtime watchdog
Automated regression tests and GitHub Actions
Sanitized settings examples and third-party license attribution

settings.sanitization: Credential-like fields and absolute user home paths removed or replaced.

excluded_categories: Downloaded ML model weights and caches
Raw Text LLM benchmark outputs from individual videos
Logs, backup copies and temporary files

distribution.native_app: Built locally with Xcode Command Line Tools and installed to /Applications
distribution.model_weights_download: Downloaded to user cache at first analysis

retained_benchmark_data: Two anonymized aggregate timing/quality metrics files and an anonymized VCE parameter-tuning summary only. The retained metric manifests use video_identity=redacted_local_sample, video_sha256=null and raw_video_and_vce_scene_payload_uploaded=false.
notice: This manifest describes the intended public distribution, provenance, and privacy boundaries. Live branch, pull-request, issue, and CI state belongs to GitHub and is intentionally not duplicated here.
